description:
calibre is the one stop solution to all your e-book needs.

calibre is an e-book manager. It can view, convert, edit and catalog e-books in all of the major e-book formats. It can also talk to e-book reader devices. It can go out to the internet and fetch metadata for your books. It can download newspapers and convert them into e-books for convenient reading. It is cross platform, running on Linux, Windows and macOS.
New features
- Read aloud: Add the high quality Kokoro voices, which sound much more natural than the Piper voices, especially for English
  To use them, select the Piper backend in the Read aloud configuration and choose one of the Kokoro voices. The voice will be automatically downloaded the first time it is used.
- News download: Support for downloading news from websites that block automated access by using the camoufox browser
  Some news sites, such as The New York Times, The Economist and The Atlantic, block all lighter weight ways of fetching their pages. Recipes for these sites now use the camoufox browser, which is automatically downloaded the first time such a recipe is run. Recipe authors can use it by setting browser_type = 'camoufox' in their recipes.
- PDF Input: Support for right-to-left text and better handling of multi-column pages
- Add support for reading images in the AVIF format
- Tag browser: A new option to sort hierarchical tags that have only children but no actual books as folders, before all other tags at their level
  Closes tickets: 2144044
- Edit book: Check book: Allow skipping of problems of a particular type
  Closes tickets: 2120771
- Edit book: ToC View: Indicate what ToC entries, if any, are in the file being currently edited
- Edit book: Check book: When auto fixing invalid ids also update CSS selectors
- E-book viewer: Add an option to display the immediate parent ToC section in headers/footers
  Closes tickets: 2169454
- E-book viewer: Allow e-books to store up to 1MB of data persistently
  Closes tickets: 2168471
- E-book viewer: Print to PDF: Allow specifying margins in metric units
  Closes tickets: 2148707
- Tag mapper and HTML/CSS transform rules: Add the ability to search the rules
  Closes tickets: 2150408
- Allow removing individual entries from the search history dropdown
  Closes tickets: 2167642
- Add a button to Preferences->Look & feel->Main interface to reset the main window layout
- Create your own Adventure: Allow exporting and importing saved games
- Speed up various operations on large libraries, such as startup, deleting many books, sorting by series, searching and refreshing the Tag browser
- Kobo driver: Add support for newer firmware
  Closes tickets: 2168472
- Windows: Unregister calibre from default programs and clear its caches when uninstalling
- DOCX Output: Make images inside links clickable
Bug fixes
- EPUB 3 to EPUB 3 conversions: Preserve ids on nav elements so links to them continue to work
  Closes tickets: 2169441
- PDF Output: Fix some trailing content at the end of individual HTML files being lost when the files use multi column layout
  Closes tickets: 2142731
- PDF Output: Fix a regression in 9.x that caused conversion of some books with vertical writing to not work correctly
  Closes tickets: 2146979
- DOCX Output: Fix non-breaking spaces not being preserved
  Closes tickets: 2167710
- FB2 metadata: Clear series, comments, etc. from the file when they are cleared in calibre
  Closes tickets: 2168996
- E-book viewer: Fix dark mode theme color overrides conflicting with e-book CSS when the book uses filters to change image colors in dark mode
- E-book viewer: Update the "Pages from paper edition" value faster
  Closes tickets: 2169232
- E-book viewer: Fix an error when pressing ctrl+shift
  Closes tickets: 2169575
- Layout actions: Fix saving/restoring layout not restoring which of the alternate book list visualisations is currently active
  Closes tickets: 2136805
- Book list: Respect horizontal alignment setting for all icon only column types
  Closes tickets: 2168620
- Cover grid: Fix one cover being rendered too small in some circumstances
- Content server: Various fixes for older browsers when using the book details page in the /mobile view
- Content server: Various security hardening fixes
New news sources
- World Socialist by Paulb223
- Poetry Magazine by flurbs
- The Believer by flurbs
- Respekt by Vector Rilke
Improved news sources
- The New York Times
- The Economist (needs subscription)
- The Atlantic
- Reuters
- Heise
- La Jornada
- Naked Capitalism
- The Saturday Paper
